snippet.title: Computer Sillow -  Gameplay Trailer!
snippet.description:
WISHLIST!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3890990/Computer_Shrilow/ 
(it wont let you click it but... like... please?)
==============
OUR WEBSITE
https://juiceboxfactory.neocities.org
==============
WELCOME TO THE COMPUTER!
Well, Its Your Computer, I suppose. Something about this familiar frontier seems a little... different? I dont think there was always a green dog in the middle of your screen, was there?? And ontop of that, is that a whole economy growing entirely inside your computer? something seems off.

SOMETHING has taken its spot front and center on your computer! suddenly, theres green dogs, shops, pets, mines, clothes?? phones??? minigames????? JOHN STONER??????? what is going ON.

GAMEPLAY

The General Gameplay of Computer Sillow takes after the classic clicker games, but obviously with its own twists, like minigames and events! and it has a plot, for some reason. aside from the basics of clicking and automating your money gain, theres many other things to do! such as minigames, events, shops, people you can talk to, pet things? and more!

The game may seem complicated at first with all its features, but through the tutorial and the general ease of access to these features, you get the hang of them quite fast! making for a fun gameplay loop that gets more unique as it goes on...


All of this is accompanied by a wonderful OST composed by our wonderful musicians nevermaur, OJSTheCoder, and some guests!

REVIEWS

Now, you may be wondering: "What do people who have already played this game think of it? give me an idea!"

So i'll give you exactly that!

The Good Game Hater (definitely not saayo)

"A really fun game and with a really entertaining story! It looks simple at first but it can really pull you in with its characters.

Easily 0 stars.

Sincerely, The Good Game Hater"

OJSTheCoder - 9.47/10

"a healthy blend of all that is clicker, culture, and minigames. a playful romp through the valley of computer shrillow brings everyone a little closer to god!"

CoolKid - SUPER MILK

"i forgot what i said again. ,FMSK i give this game a SUPER MILK! make me say that ,FMAJ"

who let this guy write a review

kesscare - kesscare

is what i would say but yea play it i like it

kesscare

Charlottefall - 10/10

"help me get me out of here i dont want to be meta PLEAAAASE"

Frumpo - 10/10

"goos"

KlutzyBugzy - nowplz/10

"play it

now

plz

LMFOAOAOA"

Shrilow - ?/10

i dont know this woman who are you
==============
